notes: Surface: printed bars in the text box, the copyright line in the border and dark full-art rims are no longer read as print lines or stains
Surface: when you checked the card and saw no marks, small light specks the scan finds are treated as likely scanner dust (wipe the glass and rescan)
Edges: soft back scans no longer show false whitening along the edge
One card at a time: the surface check comes first, and there's no PSA 10 or PSA submission list without it (you can turn this off in Settings)
History: check a real grade on PSA's or CGC's site and mark it as matching
Settings: a link to leave a review on Trustpilot
